name: SPW Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Held by "Flaming" Bob Muretic as of the federation's own late-1999 record, won in an eight-man free-for-all and defended against a growing line of contenders.

name: SPW Diamond Title
epitaph: Held jointly by Eric Henry and Andrew Davis, who had won it from Dylan Dice at Endgame, until Todd Lucchesi took it from both in a House of Anarchy three-way at Legacy in March 2002.

name: SPW Platinum Title
epitaph: Billed as the purists' title; AsH held it into Legacy in March 2002, where Gregory Brians won it five falls to four in a half-hour Ironman match.
